_meta.method: walk-forward backtest of the price estimator; see app/evaluation/backtest.py
_meta.data_source: Agmarknet variety-wise daily prices via data.gov.in (resource 35985678-0d79-46b4-9ed6-6f13308a1d24), Maharashtra districts
_meta.rule: reliability = clamp(pooled_coverage / 0.8, 0.5, 1.0), pooled per crop over evaluated weeks
_meta.caveat: measurements of the backtested sample, not a general accuracy guarantee; re-run the backtest after every estimator change
_meta.default_reliability_note: crops not measured yet get default_reliability and a visible reason code; an absent/malformed file makes the feature inert (reliability 1.0 everywhere)
